generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that None of my contracts have been terminated/foreclosed on account of my default in KPCL or elsewhere during last ten years.This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder and scanned copy should be uploaded here.

The declaration by the bidder in the letter head that My offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid. This should be neatly typed in the letter head and signed by the bidder and scanned copy should be uploaded here.

The bidder have to study the site conditions, labour conditions and read the Bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently. Uunderstood and accepted the full implications of the agreement.
The bidder shall also upload the scanned copy of the statutory documents.Income tax PAN
The bidder shall also upload the scanned copy of the statutory documents GST registration certificate
The bidder shall also upload the scanned copy of the statutory documents Independent PF code registration.
The bidder shall also upload the scanned copy of the statutory documents Labour licence certificate.

Intending Bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work in the field of HT cable laying & termination in any government/ public sector units of value not less than Rs. 8 lakhs, in the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23 , 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof of this the bidder shall upload work order and relevant work done certificate issued by an officer of the rank of Chief Engineer and competent authority. (Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year)
